material.description: Run 40192231866 (ci) on origin main 9eef7de9f7a8a3683ac9502883eca1a51eabf0db fails the built page smoke with 3 problems: console error from play.js '[mods] protection: runtime error: type error, expected table, found nil', 'unit_rules: lua error: rule missing from the pack's rules file: armour_per_point_q16', and 'no hero icon loaded in the lobby'. The same smoke passed at 6b185f62c19138a6bcfcd7a7b1a0efd7a670535b (ci run 40191326826). The range 6b185..9eef adds the 6.88g parity commits (lanmower-authored, e.g. 6.88g parity batch b02a, Building rules from the 6.88g script 96e7959e1f) and the start gate commit 2710bf816e (which also extends scripts/perf/page-smoke.mjs with a lobby-idle assertion). Owner: the lane that landed 2710bf816e and the 6.88g rules/unit_rules commits; not the asset-packs row. Fix in the owning lane: keep attr_rules.txt and unit_rules in step with protection.lua, and confirm hero icons still request their packs in the lobby before Start. Witness: ci-status on a sha containing 6b185f62 with ci success and pages success.

material.resolution: Both halves refuted on origin main: the armour rule is present in attr_rules.txt of both scenarios, and the lobby hero icon smoke is green (atlas requests=1, icons indexed=127).
